notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for update-rate designator composition across an additional-FOM join. The source uses only the official RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the rich base FOM, additional FOM module, update-rate names, provider package, endpoint, and callback configuration. It does not assert provider-specific handle values, registries, headers, or private configuration. The base/extension fixtures also provide bounded IEEE 1516.2-2025 §6.2.12 evidence: selected valid names TckFast, TckSlow, and TckAdditionalRate are processed by Create/Join and resolved through public getUpdateRateValue. The case does not reject invalid names or exhaustively test the naming rules of §3.3 or arbitrary update-rate tables.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador createFederationExecution, joinFederationExecution(additionalFomModules), getUpdateRateValue, resignFederationExecution, and destroyFederationExecution
api_surfaces.source_symbol: IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador FOM composition and update-rate lookup declarations
